title: Use control font for sort labels
prompt:
In lib/widgets/unified_item/unified_filter_sort_widget.dart, replace the exact line:
                child: Text(option.label),
with:
                child: Text(
                  option.label,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontFamily: MonoPulseTypography.fontFamilyControl,
                  ),
                ),
This applies the shared control font to both the selected sort label and the menu options while retaining their inherited size and color. Edit only the listed file; change nothing else; no refactors. When done print DONE.
